# Office read fixtures

- `sample-notes.docx`, `sample-resume.pdf`, `sample-timesheet.xlsx`,
  `synth-flate.pdf`, `synth-notext.pdf`, `synth-plain.pdf`, `synth.docx`,
  `synth.ods`: the T54 read fixtures. All content is fictional. Generated by
  hand during the T54 spike; no generator was kept.
- `far-corner.xlsx`: three real rows plus one real cell at XFD1048576. A
  reader that lays a sheet out between its extreme cells asks for 512 GiB
  here and the process aborts. Generated by `make_bound_fixtures.py`.
- `declared-huge.xlsx`: declares the whole sheet as its used range and holds
  three rows. The guard against treating a DECLARED range as a bound.
  Generated by `make_bound_fixtures.py`.
- `oversized-part.xlsx`: a worksheet part declaring more than the 64 MiB
  decompression cap, from a file of 67 KB. Generated by
  `make_bound_fixtures.py`.
- `ods-far-corner.ods`: content spanning 1,048,576 rows by 95 columns,
  which calamine lays out as 3.19 GB during the open. Generated by
  `make_bound_fixtures.py`.
- `trailing-block.ods` and `plain-3x2.ods`: the same three-row sheet with
  and without the trailing empty block LibreOffice writes at the end of
  every sheet. They must read identically; the pair is the guard against
  measuring a declared span instead of a content span. Generated by
  `make_bound_fixtures.py`.
